verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe using a multimodal model (Qwen3.5, Ministral3, llava1.6) to describe jpg/png/gif/bmp images, and describe uploading an image in chat via the `/upload` command. This clearly delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of vision use, no documentation of image input via the HTTP/API server, and no detail on how multimodal projector files are packaged or on vision-model limits.
